We have two positions (1 left, 2 right).  
- From “satire is left of fantasy”, satire must be at position 1 and fantasy at position 2.  
- “Coffee drinker is in an even position” forces the coffee drinker to be at position 2.  
- “Fisherman is right of musician” forces the musician at position 1 and the fisherman at position 2.  

Now assign the remaining attributes uniquely:  
- Position 2 already has coffee, so position 1 gets juice.  
- Position 1 has musician, position 2 has fisherman (already set).  
- Position 1 has satire, position 2 has fantasy (already set).  

Thus:  
- Satire watcher is at position 1.  
- Coffee drinker’s job is fisherman.  
- Position 2’s beverage is coffee.  
- Juice drinker’s job is musician.

<solution>1, fisherman, coffee, musician</solution>
Final answer: 1, fisherman, coffee, musician
